rootCause: Calidad rendered the complete filtered client table synchronously. Guatemala produced 416 client rows in one DOM build; Colombia produced 17. Render time scaled with row count.

fix.strategy: Keep all-country KPIs, filtering and Information Health calculations over the full dataset, but render client rows in deterministic pages of 50.

invariants: KPIs use full filtered population, not current page.
Country change clamps page to available pages.
No client, policy, receipt or insurer data is mutated.
Exact Preview must remain under 2500 ms for GT and CO.
